definitions.explanation: Describes the state of something becoming soft and pliable, especially vegetables or other foods losing their firmness through cooking or exposure to heat and salt.

examples.japanese: ⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧しんなり⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{炒|いた}める→炒める：01879_itameru⟧。
examples.english: Stir-fry until the vegetables are wilted.

examples.japanese: ⟦{塩|しお}→塩：00887_shio⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かけたら→かける：00854_kakeru⟧⟦キャベツ→キャベツ：05187_kyabetsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧しんなり⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The cabbage wilted after I added salt.

examples.japanese: {玉|たま}ねぎ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧しんなり⟦したら→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦{肉|にく}→肉：02240_niku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{加|くわ}えて→加える：01941_kuwaeru⟧さらに⟦{炒|いた}めて→炒める：01879_itameru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Once the onions have softened, add the meat and continue stir-frying.

notes:
しんなり describes food becoming soft and pliable through cooking, salting, or wilting. Very common in recipes and cooking instructions.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- しんなり⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to become wilted/soft
- しんなり⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{炒|いた}める→炒める：01879_itameru⟧: to stir-fry until wilted
- しんなりとした: softened, wilted (adjective form)

OFTEN USED WITH:
- ⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧: vegetables (general)
- ⟦キャベツ→キャベツ：05187_kyabetsu⟧: cabbage
- {玉|たま}ねぎ: onion
- ⟦{白菜|はくさい}→白菜：13606_hakusai⟧: Chinese cabbage
- ⟦ほうれん{草|そう}→ほうれん草：05188_hourensou⟧: spinach

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦くたくた→くたくた：05169_kutakuta⟧: overcooked, very soft (more extreme than しんなり)
- しなしな: wilted, droopy (often implies undesired limpness)
- ⟦しなやか→しなやか：10353_shinayaka⟧: supple, flexible (positive nuance, not limited to food)
